title: No herbal medicine at game start
recommendation: Harvest wild healroot on Day 1-2; plant healroot growing zone (Growing 8+); build drug lab for medicine crafting.
rationale: Session 1: colonists died from injuries no one could treat (no medicine).

title: No medical bed early
recommendation: Build 1-2 beds designated as medical early; assign doctor work type to best medicine pawn.
rationale: Session 1 and 3: downed colonists could not heal without a medical bed.

title: Ignoring animal threats
recommendation: Check wildlife tab for predators; draft colonists if dangerous animals near; build walls around growing zones and work areas. Do not hunt predators.
rationale: Session 1: guinea pig killed Vlad. Session 2: timber wolf killed Shin while hunting.

title: Not burying corpses
recommendation: Designate dumping stockpile for corpses or butcher them; set hauling priority high for corpse removal.
rationale: Unburied colonist corpse causes a 'left unburied' thought after 4 game days (wiki: Thoughts).

title: Mood spiral after lover death
recommendation: Monitor colonist relationships; watch for grief debuffs; have recreation and food ready during crises.
rationale: Session 1: Roni mental break after Vlad died; mood dropped to 14%.

title: Hunter killed by predator
recommendation: Do not hunt predators. Check wildlife tab for predators near hunting ground. Never hunt alone at map edge. Draft a fighter escort.
rationale: Session 2 Day 5: Shin mauled by timber wolf while hunting deer herd. Time advanced at Superfast hid the attack.

title: No freezer early
recommendation: Build 7x7 freezer room by Day 4-7, set cooler to -5C. Place near kitchen for short hauling routes.
rationale: Session 2: food rotted, colonists ate raw food, mood crashed.

title: Eating without table
recommendation: Place table + chairs in shelter on Day 1.
rationale: Eating without a table gives a mood debuff.

title: Sleeping outside or cold
recommendation: Build enclosed shelter with roof before nightfall.
rationale: Multiple mood debuffs from sleeping outside or in cold.

title: No recreation variety
recommendation: Build horseshoe pin Day 1; add chess table and TV later. 2-6 recreation types needed depending on wealth expectations (wiki: Wealth).
rationale: Mood stagnates without recreation variety. Tolerance builds with repetition (wiki: Recreation).

title: Cooking in dirty area
recommendation: Separate kitchen from workshop; floor the kitchen. Cleanliness affects food poisoning chance (wiki: Blood_loss, Bedroom).
rationale: Session 2: Peachy got food poisoning from dirty outdoor cooking area, mood crashed to 20%.

title: Small stockpile jams colony
recommendation: Make stockpiles large (49+ cells). Small zones fill to 100% and idle the whole colony.
rationale: Session 2: 6-cell stockpile hit 100% full, entire colony went idle.

title: Time control: never bare-unpause
recommendation: Always use wait_for_event with maxGameHours + pause='always'. Bare unpause at Superfast hides events and kills colonists.
rationale: Session 2: bare unpause at Superfast hid wolf kill + raid. Shin died. Session 3: sparrow attack unobserved.

title: Hunting at map edge solo
recommendation: Never hunt alone at map edge. Draft a fighter escort. Pause and watch when a hunt starts.
rationale: Session 2: Shin mauled by timber wolf at far map edge, no one near to tend her.

title: Wildlife can break into base
recommendation: Watch DangerRating and threat warnings. Wildlife can enter the base.
rationale: Session 3: wild sparrow downed 2 colonists inside base. DangerRating High.

title: Food runs low by Day 6-7
recommendation: Plant 40-60 tiles of rice on Day 1. Cook simple meals steadily. Keep 2+ weeks of food.
rationale: Session 4 and 5: low food alert by Day 8/Day 6. Rice harvest started late.

title: Construction not prioritized
recommendation: Assign Construction priority 1 to a capable pawn early. Verify blueprints actually get built. Don't let walls stall.
rationale: Session 4: 13 wall blueprints sat unbuilt for 3+ days. 'Need defenses' alert persisted Days 3-6.

title: Research bench placement
recommendation: Place research bench indoors with light. Cleanliness affects research speed (wiki: Bedroom, Research).
rationale: Session 3 and 4: 'Need research project' alert. Bench outside room airspace.

title: Medical treatment without medical bed
recommendation: Set a bed to medical early. Keep doctor assigned and medicine stocked. Injuries happen even on easy.
rationale: Session 4 Day 6: 'Medical treatment needed' despite 30 medicine. Session 5: Tyren wounded in raid, healed via medical bed.

title: Shared barracks mood penalty
recommendation: Build individual bedrooms (3x3+) early. Dull barracks -5, awful barracks -7 mood (wiki: Thoughts, Bedroom).
rationale: Session 5: moods 40-77 in shared barracks. Horseshoes pin helped +5-10.

title: Social friction: Henry (misogynist) + Chaz (female)
recommendation: Monitor social traits. Misogynist pawns may cause friction with female colonists. Separate or manage.
rationale: Session 5: Henry's mood 48-57, Chaz 51-68. Social friction observed.

title: Sandbags need cloth or Fabric/Leathery
recommendation: Plant cotton on Day 1 for cloth. MCP tool only accepted cloth; wiki says Fabric or Leathery. Re-test other materials in-game.
rationale: Session 5: 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days — no cloth for sandbags.

title: Do not pack everything into one room
recommendation: Separate room roles: bedroom (bed), dining (table+chairs), kitchen (stove), workshop (benches), hospital (medical beds), laboratory (research bench), rec room (horseshoes/TV). A room can serve multiple roles but mixing kitchen/workshop with living spaces causes problems.
rationale: Session 6: packed everything into 7x7, research bench conflicts with bed interaction spots, 'Need research bench' alert.

title: Tyren (psychopath) in melee
recommendation: Keep fighters at range. Use melee only as last resort. Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts but still feel pain.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren took knife wounds (80 HP) in close combat during raid.

title: First raid can come early
recommendation: Have weapons + sandbags ready by Day 5. First raid window is not fixed at Days 8-15 (Session 5 raid came Day 5 under Phoebe).
rationale: Session 5: raid on Day 5 (Pollution Unit, 1 raider). 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days.

title: Research set to Smithing first
recommendation: Smithing (700) is the gateway to weapons and armor. Set it on Day 1.
rationale: Session 5: Smithing completed Day 5, set Batteries next.

title: Idle colonist needs secondary work
recommendation: Give idle colonists secondary work (haul, clean, construct). Chaz idled when research bench occupied.
rationale: Session 5: '1 colonist idle' alert. Chaz wandered when research bench was occupied.

title: Tyren (psychopath) mood management
recommendation: Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts. Use recreation (horseshoes) and good food to compensate. Mood 40-77 observed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren mood 40-77. Horseshoes pin helped. Medical bed set for healing.

title: Naming dialog (faction/settlement)
recommendation: The naming dialog appears repeatedly. Close with window_action close or set text and accept.
rationale: Session 5: Dialog_NamePlayerFactionAndSettlement appeared multiple times.

title: Wait is already in progress
recommendation: wait_for_event can get stuck. Use real-time sleep (time.sleep) as fallback. Check game state after.
rationale: Session 5 and 6: 'A wait is already in progress' error from stuck wait_for_event.

title: Research bench conflicts with bed placement
recommendation: Research bench interaction spots conflict with bed placement. Plan interior layout carefully or place bench outside.
rationale: Session 6: bench placed outside due to interaction spot conflict with beds.

title: Cotton for cloth/sandbags
recommendation: Plant cotton early for cloth. Sandbags need cloth (MCP) or Fabric/Leathery (wiki).
rationale: Session 5: 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days — no cloth for sandbags.

title: Rice field sowing takes time
recommendation: Start sowing rice on Day 1. 197-cell field took 5-6 days to sow. Harvest started Day 6.
rationale: Session 5: rice harvest began Day 6. Low food alert Day 6-7.

title: Henry (misogynist) + Chaz (female) social friction
recommendation: Misogynist pawns cause social friction with female colonists. Monitor mood or separate.
rationale: Session 5: Henry mood 48-57, Chaz 51-68. Social friction observed.

title: Medical bed helps healing
recommendation: Set a bed to medical early. Tyren healed from 80 to 100 HP using medical bed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren wounded in raid (80 HP), healed to 100 via medical bed.

title: First raid can come early (Day 5)
recommendation: Have weapons + defenses ready by Day 5. First raid window is not fixed at Days 8-15.
rationale: Session 5: raid on Day 5 (Pollution Unit, 1 raider). 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days.

title: Tyren (psychopath) mood management
recommendation: Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts. Use recreation (horseshoes) and good food to compensate. Mood 40-77 observed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren mood 40-77. Horseshoes pin helped. Medical bed set for healing.

title: Naming dialog (faction/settlement)
recommendation: The naming dialog appears repeatedly. Close with window_action close or set text and accept.
rationale: Session 5: Dialog_NamePlayerFactionAndSettlement appeared multiple times.
